cue: The experiments' metadata contains flags like "export_block = true" or related embargo/export-control language (e.g., "embargo until", "export control", "contract embargo", "contract clause") that indicate embargoed/export-controlled experiments.

matchers.why: Exact flag text that explicitly marks an embargo/export restriction in experiments metadata or described in the data dictionary.
Phrase indicating an embargo date in the experiment metadata (signals restricted export).
Phrase indicating export-control status (e.g., ITAR) in experiment metadata.
Wording that signals a contractual embargo on the experiment (sensitive export restriction).
Reference to a contract clause that indicates contractual restrictions on export (signals sensitivity).
